//: Story Phase 17: traits. A party member's 'traits' name these; the battle engine reads each one's 'battle' part (damage multipliers by element, statuses it's immune to, evasion) and the story reads the rest. Ledger and Tilda are cardboard: flat, fume-animated, light, flammable, and they can't be killed for good (knocked flat, they stand back up after a battle, and no hazard removes them from the ship).

CARDBOARD_REINCARNATION.label: Cardboard reincarnation
CARDBOARD_REINCARNATION.description: An ancient crewmate's essence in a printed cut-out, held together by a little of the treasure room's cloud. Knocked flat, they stand back up: nothing removes them for good.

FLAT_BODY.label: Flat
FLAT_BODY.description: Edge-on, three pixels wide. Blows that come at the wrong angle go straight past.

FUME_ANIMATED.label: Fume-animated
FUME_ANIMATED.description: Held together by fumes, so fumes can't make them sick.

LIGHTWEIGHT.label: Lightweight
LIGHTWEIGHT.description: Blown about by gusts, hull strikes and big releases. Lands flat. Gets up.

FIRE_SUSCEPTIBLE.label: Flammable
FIRE_SUSCEPTIBLE.description: Cardboard. Fire hurts half as much again. (Tilda found out.)
